defs.meaning: 山脉；山区；山岳（mountain 的复数）

examples.en: They live up in the mountains.
There are mountains to the north.
A storm blew up over the mountains.

synonyms.meaning: 山脉；[地理]山区；山岳（mountain的复数）

translations: 阿尔泰山脉（亚洲中部山脉，在中，俄，蒙三国境内）
阿利根尼山脉（北美阿巴拉契亚山系西部的分支，等于Alleghenies）
阿特拉斯山脉（阿尔卑斯山系的一部分）

individual.mnemonic: mount（山，升起）+ ain（表示名词）→ 山

pastExamSents.en: I'm from a mountain area, where it would not be easy to make money.
pastExamSents.zh: 我来自山区，在那里赚钱不容易。

pastExamSents.en: In the school, the girl is the only student living with her grandmother in a mountain village.
pastExamSents.zh: 在学校里，这个女孩是唯一一个和她奶奶住在山村里的学生。
pastExamSents.source: 2021·黑龙江-牡丹江、鸡西地区·阅读

pastExamSents.en: She created the first free high school for girls in mountain areas and has helped more than 1,800 students to go to college.
pastExamSents.zh: 她在山区创办了第一所免费女子高中，并帮助1800多名学生上大学。

pastExamSents.en: It was finished in 2019, helping shorten the 18-km distance over the mountain to 5.7 km.
pastExamSents.zh: 隧道于2019年竣工，将18公里的路程缩短至5.7公里。

pastExamSents.en: A volunteer advised, "When climbing Qomolangma, mountain climbing lovers should always take good care of themselves, and at the same time, take good care of Qomolangma".
pastExamSents.zh: 一名志愿者建议：“登山爱好者在攀登珠穆朗玛峰时，要时刻照顾好自己，同时也要照顾好珠峰。”
